New officers join as Lecturer at Grade 9, train at BPATC or another designated institution, and teach in government colleges, teacher training colleges and Madrasah-e-Alia or work in education offices. faq.q: What is the entry post of the BCS General Education cadre?
faq.a: Lecturer in a government college (also teacher training colleges, Madrasah-e-Alia and polytechnics) at Grade 9.

faq.q: What is the salary of a BCS education cadre lecturer?
faq.a: Under the new 9th pay scale the Grade 9 basic is listed at BDT 44,000 (old scale BDT 22,000), paid in stages up to July 2027. Jagonews24 reported the entry scale as BDT 44,000-1,05,900. Check the gazette for exact figures.

faq.q: How many education posts are in the 50th BCS?
faq.a: About 185 of 1,755 cadre posts, according to circular reports: 139 general college lecturers, 26 Madrasah-e-Alia and 21 polytechnic and glass and ceramic institute posts in the reported split. Check the circular for the subject-wise list.
A special exam only for the education cadre with 683 posts (653 general colleges, 30 teacher training colleges). 312,752 applied and 668 were recommended.

faq.q: Is promotion slow in the education cadre?
faq.a: Yes, by recent reports. Lecturers generally need five years of satisfactory service, the senior scale exam and good ACRs, but limited posts delay Grade 6. Officers held a sit-in on 25 October 2026. We did not find a final fix, so check current news.
A foundation course at BPATC or another government-designated institution, followed by professional training at the workplace, with a two-year probation that can be extended.

faq.q: Can I apply with any subject?
faq.a: Not always. The circular lists subjects and required results for education posts, so check that yours qualifies.

faq.q: Does BCS General Education need a CV?
faq.a: BCS does not choose by CV. A short honest profile helps in the viva and in backup applications. For example: 'MA English graduate who tutored 12 HSC students and ran a weekly English club for 30 students.'

body_md:
**By [Daloyar Hassan Shishir](https://www.dhshishir.com)** · Career consultant, founder of Career Solutions and HereWeGrow · Facts last checked: 19 November 2026 · Last updated: 19 November 2026

> **Quick answer:** BCS (General Education) is the cadre of government college teachers and education administrators. New officers join as Lecturer at Grade 9, train at the Bangladesh Public Administration Training Centre (BPATC) or another designated institution, and teach in government colleges, teacher training colleges and Madrasah-e-Alia, or work in education offices such as the Directorate of Secondary and Higher Education (DSHE). The 50th BCS advertised about 185 education posts, and a special 49th BCS recruited for 683 posts. The entry pay scale under the 2026 pay scale is reported as BDT 44,000 to 1,05,900. The big catch is promotion: lecturers who have met the conditions often wait years for Grade 6, and in October 2026 education cadre officers staged a sit-in over it. Read the promotion section before you choose this cadre.

## Key facts (as of 19 November 2026)

| Question | Answer | Source type |
|---|---|---|
| Entry post | Lecturer in a government college (also teacher training colleges, Madrasah-e-Alia, polytechnics) | BPSC circular reports |
| Entry grade | Grade 9; entry scale reported as BDT 44,000-1,05,900 under the 2026 pay scale | Jagonews24 |
| Starting basic pay | BDT 44,000 (new 9th scale, phased in to July 2027); old scale BDT 22,000 | Daily Star Bangla; Prothom Alo |
| 50th BCS education posts | About 185 of 1,755 cadre posts (reported split: 139 general college lecturers, 26 Madrasah-e-Alia, 21 polytechnic and glass and ceramic institute) | Prothom Alo; Financial Express |
| 49th Special BCS | 683 posts; 312,752 applied; 668 recommended | bdnews24; Jagonews24 |
| Vacancies | 656 cadre lecturer posts vacant in government colleges (education minister, 8 April) | The Business Standard |
| First promotion (Grade 6) | Generally needs five years of satisfactory service, the senior scale exam, good ACRs and a vacancy | Prothom Alo |
| Foundation training | At BPATC or another government-designated institution; two-year probation | Prothom Alo |
| Exam | General BCS: preliminary 200, written 900, viva 100 | BPSC |

*Numbers can change with each circular. The BPSC circular and the gazette are the final authority.*

## What does a BCS General Education officer do?

- **Teach.** You teach your subject at a government college, usually at the higher secondary and degree level, and may supervise labs, exams and student welfare.
- **Run academic work.** Duties include exam duty, curriculum delivery, admission and college committees.
- **Work in education administration.** Officers serve in DSHE, the National Academy for Educational Management (NAEM), the National Curriculum and Textbook Board (NCTB), education boards and the Directorate of Inspection and Audit. Their main ranks are professor, associate professor, assistant professor and lecturer.
- **Lead institutions.** Senior officers become vice-principals and principals. A UNB report once recorded 135 professors named principals in a single order.

## What is the career ladder, and what is the catch?

| Rank | Pay grade | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Lecturer | Grade 9 | Entry post |
| Assistant Professor | Grade 6 | First promotion; starting basic BDT 71,000 under the 2026 scale |
| Associate Professor | Grade 5 | bdnews24 reported 765 promoted to Grade 5 in January 2025 (2015 scale) |
| Professor | Higher grade (not verified here) | Few posts |
| Principal, Director, DSHE posts | Senior | From the professor level |

**The catch is promotion speed.**

- Prothom Alo reported (sit-in on 25 October 2026) that lecturers generally need five years of satisfactory service, the senior scale exam and good ACRs, yet still wait because of limited posts. It noted 949 vacancies and 1,684 eligible officers.
- A DSHE proposal reported by BSS asked for 6,921 supernumerary posts across the professor, associate professor and assistant professor levels, and said promotion from lecturer to assistant professor was extremely limited.
- The Observer reported that between 2018 and 2023 only one lecturer-to-assistant-professor promotion took place (in 2021).
- Prothom Alo has also reported that a batch of 24th BCS officers recruited about 16 years earlier had mostly stayed at assistant professor.

We did not find a final government decision resolving this, so ask serving teachers and check current news. Some officers have left the cadre by re-sitting the BCS for other cadres, according to Prothom Alo.

## How many posts are there, and how hard is it?

| Exam | Education posts | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 50th BCS (general) | About 185 | 290,951 applied overall; 6,165 passed the written exam (23 July 2026); final result planned 25 November 2026 |
| 49th Special BCS | 683 (653 general colleges, 30 teacher training colleges) | 312,752 applied (about 456 per post); 1,219 passed the written MCQ; 668 recommended |
| Vacancies in 2026 | 656 lecturer posts vacant | Education minister, 8 April; recruitment through the 45th, 46th, 47th, 49th and 50th BCS |

After the 49th Special BCS, 651 candidates were appointed to Grade 9, and 38 recommended candidates did not join, according to Jagonews24. A special BCS lets you compete for education posts only, in the subject areas listed in the circular.

## What happens in training?

- **Foundation course.** New officers do basic training at BPATC or another designated institution, then professional and specialised training at their workplaces. The 49th BCS recruits joined at the Rural Development Academy in Bogura for an eight-day orientation.
- **Probation.** Two years, which the government may extend by up to two more.
- **Later training.** DSHE's training wing runs courses for lecturers who have not yet had pedagogy training, and NAEM trains education managers.
- **Departmental exams.** You must pass departmental exams and the senior scale exam to be confirmed and promoted.

Course details change with each batch, so check your appointment letter.

## What is the salary and what are the benefits?

The 9th National Pay Scale was approved by cabinet on 31 August 2026 and takes effect from 1 July 2026. Basic pay is raised in stages up to July 2027. Allowances are reset from January 2028.

| Grade | Old basic (BDT) | New basic (BDT) |
|---|---|---|
| 9 (Lecturer, entry) | 22,000 | 44,000 |
| 6 (Assistant Professor) | 35,500 | 71,000 |
| 5 (Associate Professor) | 43,000 | 86,000 |
| 3 | 56,500 | 1,13,000 |
| 2 | 66,000 | 1,32,000 |
| 1 | 78,000 | 1,56,000 |

*Source note: the Grade 9 and 6 figures match Prothom Alo and Jagonews24 reports of the 2026 scale; other grades come from a teacher-portal summary, not the gazette. The Daily Star Bangla confirms Grade 1 at BDT 1,56,000.*

**Benefits** (check your appointment terms): house rent and medical allowance, festival bonuses, leave and pension under government rules, a stable academic posting, and time for study and research. Coaching and private tuition rules for government teachers should be checked in the current policy before you plan any extra income.

## Which skills does a college teacher need?

| Skill | Why it matters | Demand |
|---|---|---|
| Subject knowledge | Students and colleagues test it daily | █████ |
| Teaching and classroom management | Large classes, mixed ability | █████ |
| Ethics and fairness | Grading, admissions and exam duty | █████ |
| Communication and mentoring | Students, parents and committees | ████ |
| Digital teaching tools | Online material, records and exams | ████ |
| Research and writing | Promotion, training and publications | ███ |
| Leadership | Department head, vice-principal, principal | ███ |
| Exam skills for general BCS | Bangla, English, Bangladesh Affairs, maths | ████ |

*Bars show our reading of the role, not a survey.*

## How do I get in? The exam path

Education uses the general BCS exam: a 200-mark MCQ preliminary, a 900-mark written exam (Bangla 200, English 200, Bangladesh Affairs 200, International Affairs 100, Mathematical Reasoning and Mental Ability 100, General Science and Technology 100) and a 100-mark viva. See our BCS overview for the full guide.

For education posts, the circular lists subjects and the required degree and results for each subject, so check that your subject and results qualify. The 49th Special BCS had an MCQ-style written test and then a viva. The age limit was 21 to 32 on 1 July 2025 for that exam.

**To aim for education posts:**

1. Check your subject on the circular's list and the minimum result rules.
2. Keep your academic record strong, because many posts are subject-specific.
3. Prepare the general papers (Bangla, English, Bangladesh Affairs, maths).
4. Follow the promotion debate so you go in with open eyes.
5. Keep a plan B, such as university teaching or higher study.

## Where will you find more peace of mind?

No cadre is stress-free, and we have no survey to rank them. Teaching gives regular hours, long contact with students and respect in many communities. The stress points are posting and transfer (a 2025 transfer policy says applications go through the DSHE website and that pressure or half-official letters can count against you) and slow promotion. Three habits help: build a research or training plan early, keep a good relationship with colleagues and students, and treat the first promotion wait as a long game.

## Plan your own path (5-minute worksheet)

1. **My age on the next cut-off date:** ___ (check the circular's limit)
2. **My subject and result, and whether the circular lists them:** ___
3. **My comfort teaching large classes (score out of 10):** ___
4. **Three weakest subjects for the exam:** ___, ___, ___
5. **My plan for MPhil or training while waiting for promotion:** ___
6. **My plan B if I do not get a post:** ___

Then take the free skill test on this page.

## Faith and history: the honour of the teacher

**The Quran.** The first revealed verses, Surah Al-Alaq 96:1-5, begin with the command to read and speak of teaching by the pen ([read it on quran.com](https://quran.com/96/1-5)).

**Hadith.** The Prophet (peace be upon him) said that the best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it (Sahih al-Bukhari 5027). For a teacher it is a reminder that teaching is itself worship when done with sincerity.

**History.** The general education cadre is governed by the Composition and Cadre Rules of 1980, according to a Prothom Alo report on confirmations.

## Your contribution to the nation

Government colleges educate students across districts, often those who cannot afford private options. Filling vacant lecturer posts, teaching honestly and guiding students through exams and careers is the direct way to improve the system the education minister described as short of teachers.

## Your contribution to the world

Education cadre officers can pursue research, publish and study abroad through scholarships. Teachers who mentor students into international study and research help build the country's links with the world.

## If you do not get BCS General Education

- **Other BCS cadres.** The same exam leads to Administration, Taxation, Audit and more.
- **Non-government teaching.** Non-government college teacher recruitment through the NTRCA, subject to current rules.
- **University and research routes.** MPhil, PhD, then university lectureships.
- **Private education, edtech and training roles.**

## Research opportunities

- Topics with real need: learning outcomes in government colleges, teacher shortage and workload, digital teaching, exam reform and rural education access.
- Where to learn: education and institute of education and research departments, NAEM and research groups.
- Path: a strong master's thesis, a research assistant post, then MPhil or PhD.

## Whom to follow and learn from

Follow institutions: [BPSC](https://www.bpsc.gov.bd), the [Directorate of Secondary and Higher Education](https://dshe.gov.bd), the Ministry of Education and NAEM. Treat coaching centre promises and social media rank claims with caution.

## Where do I find circulars?

- BPSC's official site: [bpsc.gov.bd](https://www.bpsc.gov.bd), including special BCS circulars.
- Teletalk's BPSC application portal: bpsc.teletalk.com.bd.
- DSHE notices for posting, training and promotion.
- Daily newspapers' job pages (cross-check every date and number with the circular).

**No lobbying.** Tadbir during the application process is treated as grounds for disqualification.

## How should I write my profile and CV?

BCS does not choose candidates from a CV. Marks decide. A short, honest profile helps in the viva and in backup applications.

| Weak line | Better line |
|---|---|
| Good teacher. | Tutored 12 students for HSC for one year; 10 passed with GPA 4 or above. |
| Interested in research. | Wrote a 15-page study on dropout in a local college and presented it at a seminar. |
| Good communicator. | Led a weekly English club for 30 students and kept attendance records. |

*Use only real, provable figures.*

Build yours free with the HereWeGrow CV Builder.

## What are the common mistakes?

- Choosing the cadre without knowing about the promotion wait.
- Not checking whether your subject and results qualify.
- Skipping written practice and relying on subject strength only.
- Treating the viva as a place for memorised answers.
- Having no plan B or research plan.
- Believing rumours about posts or promotion instead of the circular.

## Changelog

- **19 Nov 2026:** First version. The final government decision on the promotion backlog, the grade of Professor and above, the subject-wise post list for the 50th BCS and the entry age for the next circular were not confirmed; flagged in the text.
- Next planned review: when the 50th BCS final result is published or the promotion issue is settled.

## Sources and method

Facts were checked on 19 November 2026. Vacancy numbers, pay and rules can change; BPSC and the gazette are the final authority.

growth_plan.y1: Download the latest circular, check your subject and result rules, build general-paper skills (Bangla, English, Bangladesh Affairs, maths), study the promotion debate and apply when the circular opens.
growth_plan.y2: Clear the preliminary comfortably, build written-exam speed, practise a short lesson for the viva, and start a research or training plan.
growth_plan.y3: Sit written and viva with a full revision cycle; if selected, prepare for BPATC training and a college posting; if not, use your plan B (university route, other cadres, private education) and re-apply within the age limit.

Month 2: Bangla and English grammar and essays; Bangladesh Affairs notes

cv_template_notes: BCS does not select by CV, so use a clean one-page academic-style HWG layout (single column, no heavy graphics) for your viva profile, backup applications and teaching or research jobs. Lead with education and results, then teaching or tutoring, research, publications, workshops and volunteering. Add real numbers (students taught, pass results, papers). Keep it to one page. cover_letter_md:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the [position] advertised on [site/date]. I hold a [degree] in [subject] from [university] and have teaching and communication skills built while preparing for the BCS General Education cadre. In [tutoring/club role] I [one provable result, e.g. coached 12 HSC students, 10 of whom scored GPA 4 or above].

My CV is attached as a PDF. I would be glad to attend an interview.

Sincerely,
[Your name] | [Phone] | [Email]

(Note: BCS itself needs no cover letter. Use this for backup non-BCS applications.)
interview_qs: Why do you want to join the Education cadre? (Tip: Give a real reason from teaching experience; talk about students, not status.)
What does a government college lecturer do beyond teaching? (Tip: Mention exams, admissions, mentoring, committees and administrative duties.)
How would you teach a difficult topic in your subject to weak students? (Tip: Give a short example with steps, simple examples and checking understanding.)
What is your view on the slow promotion in the education cadre? (Tip: Acknowledge the concern calmly; stress service, research and long-term growth.)
What would you do if a powerful guardian asked you to raise his child's marks? (Tip: Follow the rules, document, inform the principal, stay polite.)
How can technology improve teaching in government colleges? (Tip: Shared materials, recorded lectures, online quizzes; mention access and fairness.)
Why do students drop out, and how can a college help? (Tip: Cost, distance, marriage, weak learning; offer one realistic college-level step.)
Are you ready to be posted to a remote college? (Tip: Be honest; show readiness and a practical plan.)
What is the difference between teaching and coaching? (Tip: Teaching builds understanding and values; coaching drills for exams; balance both.)
How would you handle a disruptive student? (Tip: Stay calm, private talk, understand cause, then rules.)
Why not Administration or another cadre? (Tip: Show you know the other cadre; explain your fit with teaching.)
What research would you like to do and why? (Tip: One clear topic tied to your subject and to local needs.)
Describe a time you helped someone learn. (Tip: Situation, action, result in numbers if possible.)
What will you do if you are not selected this time? (Tip: Show a calm plan B; do not sound defeated.)
Do you have any questions for us? (Tip: Ask about training or learning, not about pay or posting.)
